acceptance_criteria.then: both files are listed with modified/added marks and correct +/- counts

acceptance_criteria.given: the Changes tab listing a modified file
acceptance_criteria.how_to_check: Same drive: click the file, assert the diff lines and that the conversation pane is still visible

acceptance_criteria.given: an agent branch with two turn snapshots, each changing a different file

The only Hub diff route is GET /spec/evidence/{id}/diff (hub/hub/api/v1/spec.py:2365)

limits: How the Hub knows the task a conversation's latest turn worked was not traced in code; the route task must find it (run-task binding).
The 2-second budget for large diffs is a proposal, not measured.

open_questions.question: Which branch does the tab show when the agent builds a flow task? Answer (operator, 2026-11-13): the task branch the agent is working, or last worked.
Does 'Last turn' include uncommitted edits while a turn runs? Answer (operator, 2026-11-13): the turn's snapshot, plus a 'working now' line naming uncommitted files while it runs.
Is the tab offered from another machine and in Docker mode? Answer (operator, 2026-11-13): yes, wherever Files is offered.

problem: Today the only way to see what an agent changed is to ask it, open its worktree in an editor, or wait for a task's evidence or merge. The side panel roadmap (slice changes-view) puts the agent's changes beside the chat, as other agentic tools do. The component already exists, unwired: hub/ui/src/components/panel/ChangesTab.tsx is shown in the mock (hub/ui/mock/screens/SidePanel.tsx) with a "Last turn" and a "Since main" switch, built on the shared DiffView. The panel's tabs are declared in hub/ui/src/components/agents/ConversationView.tsx:337. No Hub route serves an agent's branch diff yet: the only diff route is evidence's (hub/hub/api/v1/spec.py:2365). The Hub already commits each turn's work as an "Auto-snapshot: <agent>'s turn" commit, so a turn has a natural boundary. A flow builder works on a task branch (task_branch_name, task_worktree_path in hub/hub/worktrees.py), not on its own agent branch (worktree_path).

requirements.statement: With a conversation open, the side panel's Changes tab lists every file the conversation's agent changed on the branch it shows, each with its path, whether it was added, modified, deleted or renamed, and its count of added and removed lines.
Selecting a listed file shows its diff in the panel, without leaving the conversation.

requirements.rationale: Last turn answers 'what did it just do'; since main answers 'what would land'.
requirements.statement: The operator can switch the tab between 'Last turn' (what the agent's most recent finished turn committed) and 'Since main' (everything on the branch that main does not have), and the tab names the branch and the base it compares with.

requirements.rationale: A flow builder's work sits on the task branch; its own branch would look empty.
requirements.statement: When the agent is working a task on a task branch, or its most recent turn was on one, the tab shows that task branch and names the task; otherwise it shows the agent's own branch.

While one of the agent's turns is running, the tab shows a 'working now' line naming the files changed in its checkout but not yet committed; when the turn ends the line goes and those changes appear under Last turn.
When a turn of the agent ends, an open Changes tab shows that turn's changes within 5 seconds, without the operator reloading.
When the agent has changed nothing, the tab says so; when the agent has no checkout of its own, or its branch cannot be read, the tab says which, instead of showing an empty list or an error code.
The tab is offered wherever the Files tab is offered, including when the app is opened from another machine and when the Hub runs in Docker mode.

A change of 200 files, or a single file diff over 5,000 lines, opens the tab within 2 seconds; binary files are listed without a diff body, and a diff too large to show whole says so and shows its start.
From a changed file, the operator can open that file in the Files tab.

in_scope: A Changes tab in the conversation's side panel, beside Specs, Files and Running
The files the conversation's agent changed and each file's diff, for its last turn and for its whole branch since main
The task branch the agent is working, or last worked, when that is where its work is
A 'working now' line naming uncommitted files while a turn runs
Opening a changed file from the tab
Offered wherever the Files tab is offered, including from another machine and in Docker mode
non_goals: Editing, reverting or staging changes from the tab: it is read-only
Commenting on a diff line or sending a review from the tab
Diffs of agents other than the conversation's own (peer conversations are the peer-conversation slice)
The Files tab's worktree switch and highlighting (files-polish slice)
A picker across all of the agent's past task branches

summary: Beside a conversation, the operator opens a Changes tab and sees which files the conversation's agent changed, with each file's diff. They can switch between what its last turn changed and everything on its branch since main. While a turn runs, a "working now" line names the files it has not committed yet. When the agent is building a flow task, the tab shows that task's branch. They never have to leave the conversation, open a terminal or ask the agent.
